items.source:
The Model interface provides a generic API for invoking AI models. It is designed to
handle the interaction with various types of AI models by abstracting the process of
sending requests and receiving responses. The interface uses Java generics to
accommodate different types of requests and responses, enhancing flexibility and
adaptability across different AI model implementations.
items.translation: Model 接口提供了一个通用的 API，用于调用人工智能模型。该接口旨在通过抽象发送请求和接收响应的过程来处理与各种类型人工智能模型的交互。该接口使用 Java 泛型来适应不同类型的请求和响应，从而增强了在不同人工智能模型实现中的灵活性和适应性。

items.source: TReq - the generic type of the request to the AI model
items.translation: TReq - AI 模型请求的泛型类型

items.source: TRes - the generic type of the response from the AI model
items.translation: TRes - AI 模型响应的泛型类型

items.source: request - the request object to be sent to the AI model
items.translation: request - 要发送给 AI 模型的请求对象

items.source: the response from the AI model
